translations.web: What man is there who has pledged to be married to a wife, and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.”
translations.bsb: Has any man become pledged to a woman and not married her? Let him return home, or he may die in battle and another man marry her.”
